title: IiILittle 12 Pack Patriotic Pinwheels
amazon_match_notes: Exact match on ASIN B0CR43JRL1: IiILittle 12-pack patriotic pinwheels, 17 in tall with a 6.3 in hub, shipped pre-assembled.

comparisons.notes: lilLittle 12-pack patriotic pinwheels, 17 in tall with a 6.3 in hub, pre-assembled, same listing copy as the Woot/ASIN item. Live page showed $35.87 and said in stock and ready to ship.

writeup: Woot has the IiILittle 12-pack of patriotic pinwheels for $8.99. Each pinwheel is 17 inches tall with a 6.3-inch hub and ships pre-assembled, no setup needed. PatioZora lists the matching lilLittle 12-pack with the same height and hub size at $35.87 and shows it in stock and ready to ship. That is 74 percent below the verified store price and saves about $27. Woot showed 3+ left with a limit of three per customer.
